_comment: Operator-maintained instrument events that no data file reports (Vaisala CL31/CL51 L1 carry the placeholder serial CL0, so an optical-block replacement is invisible). Key = <wmo>_<ident>; date = UTC day of the change; label = what changed; kalman_restart = true starts a new Kalman segment that day (the network runner), since a constant belongs to one unit. Shown as markers on the station C_L time series. Unit swaps under the same ident (CL31 -> CL51: range 7.7 -> 15.4 km) are calibrated day by day with the type the range extent gives (calibration/io/vaisala_type.py); the runner logs a swap that has no event here.
